name: QA evidence
description: Repo-local WorkContext message example for recording QA evidence on a Relay PR or branch; not a universal Relay QA schema.

fields.scope: Relay issue, PR, WorkContext, or feature area under QA.
fields.exactHead: Branch and commit SHA that was tested.
fields.commands: Automated commands run and their pass/fail dispositions.
fields.scenarioEvidence: Manual or browser scenarios exercised, including screenshots/artifact references when available.
fields.status: QA verdict such as pass, blocked, or partial.
fields.blockers: Evidence-backed blockers, if any, with reproduction notes.

example.summary: QA evidence for PR #123 at abc1234: targeted checks passed

scenarioEvidence.scenario: Repo-local message templates list and render from .relay/messages
